svg.text: As provisioned by the shipped IaC: deploy/terraform/aws (VPC · EKS · RDS · MSK · ElastiCache · S3 · OpenSearch · ECR · KMS · Secrets Manager) + Helm umbrella chart (values-aws.yaml)
VPC — private subnets across AZs, security groups per tier
vpc.tf · iam.tf (IRSA roles) · secrets.tf / secrets_backend.tf (External Secrets sync into the cluster)
eks.tf — managed node groups · workload identity (IRSA) · images from ECR (ecr.tf)
Helm umbrella chart, one Deployment per service,
• AI plane: agent-runtime, ai-gateway, memory, eval, tool-plane
• Data plane: ingestion, dataset, semantic, query, chart
• Governance: case, rbac, audit, notification, realtime-hub
Argo Workflows server: infra-gated add-on — orchestrator ships
the submit/watch client; server install is a deploy-time choice
g5.xlarge → p4d.24xlarge instance types, tainted so
only training Jobs schedule here; scales to zero
training without touching the services pool
pipeline runs are lease-held; a pod lost to scale-in or
eviction stops heartbeating and the orphan reaper
recovers the run on another instance — no stranded
migration 0004 · every instance sweeps, claim is one conditional UPDATE
CloudWatch log groups (terraform) · Prometheus rules + Grafana dashboards + ServiceMonitors (chart templates) · Tempo tracing
ECR with lifecycle policies — CI pushes ghcr/ECR images tagged by commit SHA; Helm pins global.imageTag at deploy
External Secrets Operator syncs AWS Secrets Manager → k8s secrets (templates/externalsecret.yaml + secrets_backend.tf)
ecr.tf · secrets.tf · KMS-encrypted at rest (kms keys in s3.tf/rds.tf/msk.tf)

g.text: Amazon RDS — PostgreSQL 16
system of record for all services · FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY per tenant · non-superuser app roles enforced at boot
rds.tf
Amazon MSK — Apache Kafka
event backbone · transactional outbox relay (nothing publishes before its DB transaction commits) · SCRAM auth
msk.tf
Amazon ElastiCache — Redis
consumer dedup, semantic-cache index, rate limits, sandbox-reaper leader election
elasticache.tf
Amazon S3
datasets (parquet), model artifacts, scoring outputs, audit archive · versioned, SSE-encrypted, public access blocked
Iceberg lakehouse tables live here behind the in-cluster REST catalog + Trino
s3.tf
Amazon OpenSearch Service
RAG keyword/hybrid retrieval (memory-service) + audit search · per-tenant index sharding sized by terraform output
opensearch.tf
AWS KMS + Secrets Manager
at-rest encryption keys for RDS/S3/MSK · runtime secrets synced into the cluster via External Secrets
iam.tf · secrets.tf
LLM providers — brokered by ai-gateway, never called directly by agents
Anthropic API and/or Amazon Bedrock (Claude), configured per tenant · semantic cache, token budgets and
cost metering sit in front of every call · prompts never leave the VPC except to the configured provider
Trust boundary notes
• Tenant isolation is enforced in Postgres (FORCE RLS) — not in application code an attacker could skip
• Audit chain hashes are verifiable off-platform; archive bucket is versioned and access-blocked
• Agent writes require a four-eyes approval that mints an RS256-signed execution grant — cloud IAM
compromise alone cannot make an agent's proposal execute

svg.text: dev / CI: docker-compose parity stack (same images: pgvector 16, Redpanda, MinIO, Keycloak, Temporal, Trino, Iceberg REST, OPA, Vault, MLflow, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, otel+Tempo) — this is the tier where the 3,029-test evidence run executed.

cloud: this page — terraform apply (deploy/terraform/aws) then helm upgrade -f values-aws.yaml. Also shipped: values-gcp.yaml, values-azure.yaml, values-hetzner.yaml — the platform is cloud-portable because every stateful dependency is open-source.

Honesty note: the AWS/GCP/Azure paths are the shipped, reviewed IaC — they are infra-gated and have not been exercised from the evaluation sandbox (no cloud credentials there). The executed-verification tier to date is local/CI.
Source: deploy/terraform/aws/*.tf, deploy/helm/datacern (values-aws.yaml), deploy/k8s/data-tier at commit 54cfe2d · generated 2026-07-30
